The instrument features a symmetrical facade with multiple ranks of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, arranged in a stepped silhouette. The casing is constructed from pinkish-beige wood with decorative moldings and gilded accents. A central console area is visible below the main pipe array, though specific details like manuals and pedalboards are partially obscured by the angle and distance.
